card.name: Inside enzyme brand names before -ZYME
card.fires_on: The piece just before a word-ending like ZYME or XYMALTOSE inside capitalized enzyme or iron product names (NAGLAZYME, FABRAZYME, XENPOZYME). Also fires on a piece before a final Y in some all-caps words.

card.writes: It predicts that the next piece is a word ending that starts with Y, such as ZYME or XY.
card.plain: It spots the middle of a long brand name where the next piece will be an ending starting with Y, like -zyme.
